messages.en:
{07 16 00}Just 'cause all fish swim
in the water doesn't make
'em all the same, y'know!
{07 00 00}Hang tight for a bit.{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 16 00}I'm tryin' to catch a crazy
rare one now, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}See, et kõik kalad ujuvad
vees, ei tee neid veel
ühesuguseks, tead!
{07 00 00}Oota natuke.{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 16 00}Üritan praegu püüda hullult
haruldast, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Have you caught a fish that
sets your soul on fire,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 15 00}Well, I haven't yet!{01 01 00}
But hang tight, 'cause
I WILL!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kas sa oled püüdnud kala,
mis paneb su hinge põlema,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 15 00}Noh, mina pole veel!{01 01 00}
Aga oota, sest
MA PÜÜAN!
